title: Kissed Buttery Jamaican Lamb Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Jamaican dish featuring lamb leg, this recipe is low in sodium and full of flavor, with a buttery and shaggy texture that is sure to please, the combination of spices and herbs gives it a unique taste.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, jamaican jerk seasoning, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the butter and spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
